name: PictureThis
description: Your textbook figures come alive: Mentra Live notices a figure on the page you are reading, chimes, and your phone turns it into an interactive 3D model.

permissions.description: Looks at the textbook page you are reading to find figures that can be brought to life.

hardwareRequirements.description: Chime when a figure is found
Tap to look now, hold to pause
